context: The market has risen for days without a major retracement. November 4 saw selling, then a retracement and a recovery, so buyers are seated; sellers have already been driven out. Today is Sensex's weekly expiry.
plan: GAP UP -> BUY, WITH THE MARKET: the seated buyers are already in good profit; identify buying-side setups.
FLAT TO GAP DOWN -> SELL: target the seated buyers; identify selling-side setups.
